mapper.sql: auto_id, lane_id, proc_inst_id, node_inst_id, shard_key, status, error_policy, config, result, creator_id, updator_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ${orch.table.lane}(lane_id, proc_inst_id, node_inst_id, shard_key, status, error_policy, config, creator_id, updator_id) VALUES(#{laneId}, #{procInstId}, #{nodeInstId}, #{shardKey}, #{status}, #{errorPolicy}, #{config}, #{creatorId}, #{updatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ${orch.table.lane} l JOIN ${orch.table.processInst} p ON p.proc_inst_id = l.proc_inst_id SET l.status = 'running' WHERE l.lane_id = #{id} AND l.status = 'pending' AND p.status = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT l.lane_id FROM ${orch.table.lane} l JOIN ${orch.table.processInst} p ON p.proc_inst_id = l.proc_inst_id WHERE l.status = 'pending' AND p.status = 'running' ORDER BY l.auto_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
